title: Grade 4 French — Mon, Jun 01
description: Verbes en -IR (2e groupe) — Day 1 of 5: Introduction and singular forms (je, tu, il/elle)
subject: french

questions.question: Last week we learned -ER verbs. This week's verbs end in which letters?
questions.explanation: This week = the 2nd group: regular verbs ending in -IR, like finir, choisir, grandir.

questions.question: What does 'finir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Finir' = to finish. It is the model verb for the 2nd group (-IR verbs).

questions.question: What does 'choisir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Choisir' = to choose. 'Je choisis un livre.' = I choose a book.

questions.question: What does 'grandir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Grandir' = to grow / to grow up. 'Les enfants grandissent vite.' = Children grow up fast.

questions.question: To conjugate a 2nd-group -IR verb, you first remove which ending?
questions.explanation: Remove '-ir' from the infinitive to get the stem: finir → fin-. Then add the endings.

questions.question: Conjugate 'finir' for 'je':
questions.explanation: 'Je finis' = I finish. Singular endings for -IR verbs: je -is, tu -is, il/elle -it.

questions.question: Conjugate 'finir' for 'tu':
questions.explanation: 'Tu finis' = you finish. 'Tu' takes -is, same as 'je'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Je ___ un gâteau au chocolat.' (choisir)
questions.explanation: 'Je choisis un gâteau au chocolat.' = I choose a chocolate cake. Je → -is.

questions.question: Complete: 'Tu ___ ton travail.' (finir — you finish your work)
questions.explanation: 'Tu finis ton travail.' = You finish your work. Tu → -is.

questions.question: What does 'réussir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Réussir' = to succeed. 'Elle réussit son examen.' = She passes her exam.

questions.question: Complete: 'Elle ___ son examen.' (réussir — she passes her exam)
What does 'obéir' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Obéir' = to obey. 'Le chien obéit.' = The dog obeys.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct for 'I choose'?
Complete: 'Il ___ vite.' (grandir — he is growing fast)
questions.explanation: 'Il grandit vite.' = He is growing fast. Il → -it.
